messages:
maria: Heads-up — PM wants a console toggle for 'invocation fidelity' so users can flip between amortized session cost and raw per-call burn. Is this realistic without shipping huge storage?
sam: Short answer: yes if we sample. Full raw-per-invocation for all tenants = big spike (TBs/day). We already store tokenline samples at 1%.
josh: Also: routing/fallbacks confuse attribution. If a request is routed to fallback model, cost should attribute to the actual served model/route, not the original intent. We need runtime metadata.
lina: Mechanically we could attach an x-cost-context header with model_sku/cache_key/etc, but I don't love adding that to the public API surface.
sam: Agreed — don't bloat public SDK. Router/sidecar should inject cost meta into our internal event stream instead. No new public header.
maria: PM wants near-real-time preview in the console (<5s) when toggling. Recomputing the whole day won't fly.
josh: Implementation idea: precompute two rollups (amortized and raw-sampled). UI toggle switches which precomputed view to read; for recent window preview we extrapolate from raw sampled stream.
lina: Need to handle canaries & fallbacks: runtime must emit the actual served-sku and a cache_hit boolean. Attribution rules should be deterministic: served-sku wins, then route.
sam: Proposed plan: 1) runtime emits cost_event {model_sku, tokens_in, tokens_out, cache_hit, prompt_hash, prompt_len} 2) pipeline enriches with route/tenant 3) UI shows toggle plus sample-rate badge. Note: no prompt text.
maria: Action items: RFC, runtime proto change (cache_hit + served_sku), router injection, console feature-flag `invocation_fidelity_v1` for beta.
josh: I'll take the runtime proto PR + unit tests. ETA 1 week for PR, 2 weeks for end-to-end beta?
sam: I'll handle pipeline enrichment + sample-rate config per-tenant. Also will add guard to never include prompt text (only hash/len).
lina: I'll spec the UX: toggle, sample-rate indicator, and a little explainability tooltip about extrapolation assumptions.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy of router v2 succeeded in prod (canary=5%).
maria: Nice. @josh please add tests asserting cache_hit increments cache-savings column and that fallback attribution maps to served-sku. @sam please add docs for default sample-rate and opt-out.
sam: On it. Filing RFC now: https://r.company/RFC-1234
maria: Thanks all — let's sync Tuesday if blockers come up. :thumbsup:
